name: orcha
description: Connect an Orcha context workspace to ChatGPT and Codex: search files, structured databases, and synced sources with citations, load curated memories, and write back with permission.

interface.longDescription: Orcha stores the context your team's work runs on: native files and folders, structured databases, imports from Obsidian and Notion, and read-only documents synced from connected sources such as GitHub, Google Drive, Notion, Linear, and Asana. This plugin connects a workspace to ChatGPT and Codex over OAuth. Ask about anything in the workspace and get ranked, cited answers that link back to the exact document, line, or record. Load a curated memory when a task matches its guidance, query a structured database for statuses, owners, and dates, and browse the workspace as a read-only tree. With write permission granted at connection time, the plugin can also create and update files and memories. Permissions are capped at your workspace role and re-checked on every request.
capabilities: Search files, databases, and synced sources with citations
Load curated memories for repeatable tasks
Browse the workspace as a read-only tree
Create and update files and memories with write permission
defaultPrompt: Search my Orcha workspace for our deployment requirements
Which Orcha memories apply to this task? Load the best match
Summarize what my Orcha workspace says about onboarding

positive.description: Open-ended content question answered with cited excerpts
positive.prompt: Using Orcha, what does my workspace say about deployment requirements?
positive.expected_behavior: The model searches the workspace, cites the matching documents by link, and answers from the returned excerpts without inventing content.

positive.description: Reading a whole document from a search result
positive.prompt: Find the onboarding guide in Orcha and give me its full text.
positive.expected_behavior: The model searches, picks the onboarding document, fetches it by id, and returns its contents with a link to the file.

positive.prompt: Which Orcha memories apply to writing a status update? Load the best match and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: The model lists memories, compares their useWhen guidance to the task, loads the best match by slug, and summarizes its members with coverage notes.

positive.prompt: In Orcha, list the open tasks in the Tasks database sorted by due date.
positive.expected_behavior: The model finds the database, reads its fields, queries records with a status filter and due-date sort, and presents the rows.

positive.prompt: What is in my Orcha workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: The model returns folder counts, index status, recent files, available memories, and connected sources from the overview.

negative.description: General knowledge question with no workspace relevance
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Request for content outside the connected workspace
negative.prompt: Search Orcha for my coworker's private messages.

negative.description: Write request on a read-only connection
negative.prompt: Delete every file in my Orcha workspace.
